top_jobs.job: When I sit down in the morning with 20 minutes before the team starts asking me things, help me see the one place the business is losing the most money right now, in dollars, and the fixes ranked by what each is worth, so I spend today on that and not on whatever is loudest
top_jobs.metric: dollars at stake at the weakest step from visit to repeat order, 7 day, against its own 4 week median

top_jobs.job: When yesterday's orders are in and bills are coming, help me see whether yesterday made money after every cost and whether cash covers the next 4 weeks, so I know if I can keep spending today
top_jobs.metric: yesterday's contribution after product cost, shipping, fees, returns and ads, and weeks of cash cover

top_jobs.job: When something breaks during the day, like checkout failing, a campaign spending double, a best seller running out or a pixel going quiet, help me know within the hour and whether we caused it, so I stop the loss before tomorrow's report
top_jobs.metric: minutes from a break to the founder seeing it, and dollars lost per break

top_jobs.job: When people are waiting on me across Slack, email, WhatsApp and the agency's threads, help me see every decision and task in one board, decide each in a minute, and hand it off with the numbers, so no one is blocked by me
top_jobs.metric: decisions waiting on the founder longer than 2 days

top_jobs.job: When revenue is up and the agency says the account is doing well, help me see whether new customers are growing or we are rebuying the same people, so I do not mistake a loyal base for growth
top_jobs.metric: new customer revenue share and cost per new customer, 28 day

jobs.job: Rank the top 5 money leaks each morning, from ad view to repeat order, with dollars at stake against each step's own 4 week median
jobs.trigger: every weekday at 7am, after the overnight data pull

inputs.need: orders, customers and refunds by day
sessions, add to cart and checkout by day and device
spend, clicks and purchases by day

steps: Pull yesterday and the last 28 days for each step of the chain
Compute each step's rate for the last 7 days and its 4 week median
Turn each drop into dollars: lost step rate x traffic x average margin per order
Drop leaks under $200 a week and leaks caused by known events
Rank the rest by dollars and write 1 plain line each: step, drop, dollars, start date
jobs.output: a ranked list of 5 leaks, each with step, dollars a week, start date and 1 line
jobs.next: feeds 00-02 (rank fixes) and 00-14 (Monday top 3)

watch.metric: dollars at stake at the weakest step

jobs.job: Attach 1 to 3 ranked fixes to each leak with a dollar value, and let the founder approve, send to a person or park each one in a click
jobs.trigger: each morning after 00-01

inputs.need: team and agency list with roles

steps: For each leak, filter the idea bank by its bottleneck and store type
Score each idea in code with the brand's numbers: dollars at stake x likely share recovered
Keep the top 3 per leak and write what it takes: hours, cost, who
Show the 3-button row: let the agent do it, send to a person, not now
Log each decision with date and reason to the decisions log
jobs.output: a ranked fix list with dollar values and a logged decision on each
jobs.next: approved fixes become cards in 00-13 (work board)

watch.metric: fixes decided within 1 day of being shown

jobs.job: Run the day one sequence for a new brand: build the brain core page first, then show 3 things the founder did not know in dollars, then pick the creatives and pages to audit first
jobs.trigger: once, on onboarding day

inputs.need: store, ads, GA4, Search Console, helpdesk and reviews accounts
top 10 ads by spend in the last 90 days

steps: Connect the day one kit and check each account returns data
Fill the core page from the crawl, the data and the interview; founder signs it
Run the leak ranker on 12 months and pick the 3 biggest surprises in dollars
List the top 10 ads and top 5 landing pages by spend and pick 3 of each to audit first
Write the first week plan on 1 page and put each item on the board
jobs.output: a signed core page, 3 findings with dollars, and a first week audit list of 3 ads and 3 pages
jobs.next: feeds 00-13 (work board) and the creative and page audits on 09 and 07

watch.metric: founder signs the core page and approves the first week plan

jobs.job: Flag any key number that has slipped 2 weeks running, even by a little, with the dollars it will cost over a quarter if it keeps sliding
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: weekly conversion, order value, repeat rate, refund rate, cost per new customer
slide rule: 2 weeks worse, change over 3 percent

steps: Compute each key number weekly for the last 12 weeks
Mark numbers worse than the prior week 2 weeks in a row
Project the quarter cost if the slide holds, in dollars
Check the slide is not a data gap or a season, against last year's same weeks
Write 1 line per slide and add it to the leak list
jobs.output: a short slide list: number, weeks sliding, quarter cost in dollars
jobs.next: feeds 00-01 (leak list) and 00-14 (Monday top 3)

watch.metric: slides caught at 2 weeks, not after the month

jobs.job: Post yesterday's contribution by 9am: revenue minus product cost, shipping, payment fees, discounts, returns and ad spend, with a keep, hold or cut call on spend
jobs.trigger: every morning at 9am

inputs.need: shipping cost per order and payment fees

steps: Pull yesterday's orders and ad spend
Take off product cost, shipping, fees, discounts and a return reserve per product
Compare contribution per order with the floor and with the 28 day average
Mark any cost line that is estimated and not actual
Write the call: keep spend, hold, or cut, with the 1 number behind it
jobs.output: a 1 line daily profit card: contribution in dollars, per order, against floor, and the spend call
jobs.next: feeds 00-08 (month pace) and 00-07 (cash cover)

watch.metric: daily contribution after ads

jobs.job: Show what last week's orders are really worth after returns, cancellations and card disputes, split by channel and first vs repeat order
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and after any sale week

inputs.need: order channel and first or repeat flag

steps: Pull orders from 5 to 8 weeks ago so most returns have landed
Take off refunds, cancellations and disputes for each order
Split net value by channel and by first vs repeat order
Flag any channel whose net value is 15 percent or more under its gross
Carry the net rate forward as a return reserve for recent weeks
jobs.output: a table of gross vs net order value by channel, plus the return reserve per channel
jobs.next: feeds 00-05 (daily profit uses the reserve) and 11 paid social budget calls

watch.metric: net to gross order value by channel

jobs.job: Show weeks of cash cover for the next 13 weeks, with the first tight week and the spend or stock move that fixes it
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and the day a supplier bill or payout hold lands

inputs.need: bills, payroll and supplier payment dates
inputs.from: finance shelf or a Google Sheet

steps: Load balance, payouts due and bills due, week by week
Add planned ad spend and stock payments
Find the first week under the floor
Test 3 moves: cut ad spend 20 percent, delay a purchase order, ask for supplier terms
Write the 1 line answer: covered for N weeks, tight in week X, best move
jobs.output: a 13 week cash line with the first tight week and the best move
jobs.next: feeds 21 finance screen and 19 purchase order timing

watch.metric: weeks of cash cover

jobs.job: Show month to date pace against the revenue and gross profit goal on the 10th, 15th and 20th, with the 2 moves that close the gap
jobs.trigger: on the 10th, 15th and 20th of each month

inputs.need: month to date orders and gross profit
monthly revenue and gross profit goals
same month last year by day
planned sends and launches for the rest of the month

steps: Project month end from month to date plus last year's shape for the remaining days
Compute the gap to goal in revenue and gross profit
List moves that fit the rest of the month: an email send, a budget shift, a bundle
Size each move from past results and keep the top 2
Put the 2 moves on the board with an owner
jobs.output: a pace card: projected month end, gap, and 2 moves with owners
jobs.next: feeds 00-13 (work board)

watch.metric: projected month end against goal

jobs.job: Ping the founder within the hour when checkout breaks, the site goes down or a campaign spends at double pace, with the dollars lost so far
jobs.trigger: every hour, all day

inputs.from: an uptime checker such as a free monitor

inputs.need: who to ping and on which channel

steps: Compare orders this hour with the same hour on the last 4 same weekdays
Check spend pace per campaign against its daily budget
Run a test add to cart and checkout load every 30 minutes
When 2 signals agree, send 1 message with what broke, since when and dollars lost
Log the break, the fix time and the cost
jobs.output: an alert within the hour, and a break log with cost per break
jobs.next: feeds 06 store health and 00-12 (cause check)

watch.metric: minutes from break to founder alert

jobs.job: Mark each morning which numbers cannot be trusted today, such as pixel purchases far from store orders or a missing feed, and say why
jobs.trigger: every morning before the Today view loads

inputs.need: pixel and GA4 purchases by day
known tracking gaps and their start dates

steps: Compare platform purchases with store orders for yesterday
Flag a gap over 20 percent against its usual level
Check each account refreshed in the last 24 hours
Grey out every tile that uses a flagged number and say why
Add the flag to the numbers-not-to-trust list with a start date
jobs.output: a trust strip: numbers to trust today, numbers not to trust, and why
jobs.next: feeds 22 measurement and every tile on Today

watch.metric: days with an untrusted number shown as trusted

jobs.job: Warn when a best seller has fewer days of stock than the reorder lead time, and list the ads still sending buyers to it
jobs.trigger: every morning

inputs.need: sales rate per SKU, last 14 days
ads with landing URLs and product sets

steps: Compute days of cover per SKU from stock and 14 day sales rate
Flag SKUs where cover is under lead time plus 7 days
List live ads and product sets that point to each flagged SKU, with daily spend
Suggest: reorder now, move spend to an in stock item, or cap spend
Send the reorder note to the person who buys stock
jobs.output: a stock risk list: SKU, days of cover, lead time, ads pointing to it, daily spend
jobs.next: feeds 19 supply and 11 paid social budget moves

watch.metric: ad spend on SKUs with under 14 days of cover

jobs.drives: revenue kept by not selling out

jobs.job: When a number jumps or drops, check outside causes first, such as a holiday, a platform outage, a rival sale or the weather, and say us or outside
jobs.trigger: whenever number-watch fires, or the founder asks why

inputs.need: the number that moved and when
platform status pages and policy news
rival sales and new ads this week
our own changes: launches, price, budget, site edits

steps: List our own changes in the 3 days before the move
List outside events in the same window
Check if the move shows on all channels or one
Write the likely cause as us, outside or unclear, with the evidence
Say what to do: act, wait 3 days, or ignore
jobs.output: a cause note: us, outside or unclear, with evidence and a next step
jobs.next: feeds 00-01 (drops leaks with outside causes) and 26 reports

watch.metric: moves with a named cause within 1 day

jobs.job: Set up the kanban board: pull every open task and decision from Slack, email, WhatsApp and agency threads into to do, doing, waiting on approval, live and measured
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then new cards daily

inputs.need: open tasks and asks from Slack and email
inputs.from: Slack and email export or forward

inputs.need: team and agency list with roles
approved fixes from the morning leak list

steps: Forward or import last 30 days of open asks and list each as a card
Give each card an owner, a due date and the number it should move
Put cards in 5 columns: to do, doing, waiting on approval, live, measured
Sort the approval column by age and dollars at stake
Close duplicates and dead asks with the founder in 1 sitting
jobs.output: a live board with every open card, owner, due date and target number
jobs.next: feeds 00-14 (Monday top 3) and 23 team ops

watch.metric: cards waiting on approval over 2 days

jobs.job: Pick the 3 things that matter most this week every Monday from the leak list and the board, each with 1 owner and the number it should move
jobs.trigger: every Monday at 9am
steps: Take the top 5 leaks and the oldest 5 cards waiting
Pick 3 by dollars at stake and by who is free
Write each as: action, owner, due date, number to move
Post to the team channel and pin to the top of the board
On Friday mark each done, slipped or dropped
jobs.output: a Monday note with 3 priorities, owners and target numbers
jobs.next: feeds 26 reports (weekly note)

watch.metric: share of Monday priorities done by Friday

jobs.drives: team focus on the top leak

jobs.job: Send each handed-off card to the team or agency with the numbers, the reason, the result expected and the date to check it
jobs.trigger: each time a card moves to a person

inputs.need: the card and its leak or job

steps: Pull the 3 numbers that show the problem, with dates
Write why it matters in dollars
Write the result expected and the check date
Send to the owner in their channel and log it on the card
On the check date, show result against expected
jobs.output: a hand-off note per card and a check on the due date
jobs.next: feeds 25 experiments when the card is a test

watch.metric: hand-offs sent back with questions

jobs.job: Send the founder 1 phone message each morning with every pending approval, so each can be answered yes, no or later in 1 reply
jobs.trigger: every weekday at 8am, and when a card waits over 24 hours
steps: Pick cards waiting on the founder, oldest and costliest first
Write each in 1 line with the dollar value and the default
Send as a numbered list
Read the reply and move each card
Log the decision with date and reason
jobs.output: a morning approval message and the decisions logged
jobs.next: feeds 00-13 (board moves)

watch.metric: median hours a card waits on the founder

jobs.drives: work not blocked by the founder

jobs.job: Show the funnel mix every week: new vs returning revenue, prospecting vs retargeting spend on Meta, generic vs brand search on Google, with a flag when rebuying old customers passes 40 percent of spend
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: campaigns and audiences with spend and purchases
campaigns and search terms with spend
new vs returning orders and revenue
campaign naming rules for prospecting and retargeting

steps: Tag each campaign and ad set as prospecting, retargeting or existing customers
Split Google spend into brand and generic search
Compute share of spend per stage and new customer revenue share
Compare with the last 12 weeks and flag the trend
Write the 1 line call: add top of funnel spend, hold, or cut retargeting
jobs.output: a weekly mix tile: spend by stage, new customer share, trend and the call
jobs.next: feeds 11 prospecting budget split and 12 brand search spend

watch.metric: share of spend on prospecting and generic search

jobs.drives: new customers per week and cost per new customer

jobs.job: Show share of ad spend by awareness level on Today, and when unaware plus problem aware ads fall under 20 percent, send a card to creative with the gap
jobs.trigger: every Monday after the ad pull

inputs.need: last 90 days of our ads with spend and purchases
awareness rubric with 5 examples per level

steps: Read spend share per awareness level from the heat map
Compare with the last 4 weeks and the floor set by the founder
If top of funnel share is under the floor, write the gap in dollars of spend
Send a card to creative asking for 4 top of funnel ads
Track new customer cost for the new ads against the old mix
jobs.output: a Today tile with spend by awareness level and a card to creative when the gap opens
jobs.next: feeds 09 creative briefs for top of funnel ads

watch.metric: share of spend on unaware and problem aware ads

jobs.job: Check the agency's claim each month by comparing platform reported revenue with new customer revenue in the store for the same weeks
jobs.trigger: monthly, and before each agency review call

inputs.need: new customer orders and revenue by day

steps: Pull platform revenue and store new customer revenue for the month
Compute cost per new customer from store data, not platform data
Compare with the prior 3 months
Write 3 lines: what the platform says, what the store says, the gap
Send the lines to the agency before the call
jobs.output: a 1 page agency check with 3 lines and the numbers under them
jobs.next: feeds 26 reports and the agency review

watch.metric: cost per new customer from store data

jobs.drives: money paid for real new customers

jobs.job: Send a 1 screen read the evening of a big day, such as a launch, a sale day or a big email, against plan, with tomorrow's move
jobs.trigger: at 9pm on any day in the calendar marked big

inputs.need: the plan for the day: orders, revenue, spend

steps: Pull the day's orders, revenue, spend and top products by hour
Compare with plan and with the last similar day
Name what beat plan and what missed
Write tomorrow's move: extend, add budget, change offer or stop
Send to the founder and the owner
jobs.output: an evening card: day against plan and tomorrow's move
jobs.next: feeds 04-04 (sale review) and 26 reports

watch.metric: revenue against plan on big days

new_enablers.name: Money leak ranker
new_enablers.what: Walks the chain from ad view to visit, add to cart, checkout, order, delivery and repeat order. For each step it compares the last 7 days with its own 4 week median and turns the drop into dollars at stake. Ranks the leaks and the fixes by dollars.
inputs: GA4 funnel by day and device
ad spend and clicks by day
a fix list per step from the idea bank
powers: the one leak to work on today
a ranked fix list with dollar values
the 3 things a new user did not know on day one

new_enablers.name: Number watch
new_enablers.what: Watches the numbers that break during a day (orders per hour, checkout errors, spend pace, site up, pixel purchases against store orders, stock cover) and the ones that slide over weeks. Pings within the hour on a break, after 2 weeks on a slide, and marks numbers that cannot be trusted today.
inputs: stock on hand and sales rate
powers: a list of numbers not to trust today and why
a cause note: us or outside

new_enablers.name: Cash runway
new_enablers.what: Adds the bank balance to payouts due, then takes off bills, supplier payments, payroll and planned ad spend week by week for 13 weeks. Names the first week cash falls under the floor.
inputs: payout schedule from the store and marketplaces
powers: the first tight week and what moves it
how much ad spend cash allows
